title: Openwell Submersible Pumpsets — Specification
scope: Covers requirements for openwell submersible pumpsets (monoset or motor and pump coupled) for handling clear, cold water up to 33°C, for agricultural and rural water supply purposes up to 45 kW.

amendments.summary: Updates to testing tolerances and cable gland specifications as per Product Manual PM/IS 14220.

structured_parameters.requirement_text: Overall efficiency of the openwell pumpset shall not be less than the values specified in Table 1 corresponding to the rated head and discharge point. Tested strictly in accordance with IS 11346.
structured_parameters.notes: VERIFIED FACT: Efficiency is determined dynamically from Table 1 curves based on duty point (head H and discharge Q) and tested as per IS 11346. PENDING VERIFICATION: Numerical scalar cutoff (such as fixed 35%) is not universally valid across all ratings and must not be used as a hard regulatory rule without duty point inputs.

structured_parameters.requirement_text: Pump casing shall withstand hydrostatic test pressure of 1.5 times the maximum discharge pressure or 2.0 bar, whichever is higher, for a minimum duration of 2 minutes without leakage.
structured_parameters.notes: VERIFIED FACT: 1.5x max discharge pressure or 2.0 bar minimum for 2 minutes without leakage.

structured_parameters.requirement_text: Motor shall be capable of operating satisfactorily with supply voltage variation of +6% to -15% of rated voltage (415V for 3-phase, 240V for 1-phase).
structured_parameters.notes: VERIFIED FACT: Evaluated at rated frequency of 50 Hz ± 3%.

structured_parameters.requirement_text: Insulation resistance between winding and motor frame shall not be less than 20 Megaohms when measured with 500V DC megger in dry condition and 5 Megaohms after immersion test.
structured_parameters.notes: VERIFIED FACT: Minimum 5 Megaohms post-immersion with 500V DC test voltage.

certification.applicable_provisions: BIS Conformity Assessment Regulations 2018, Product Manual PM/IS 14220

qco.issuing_ministry: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
qco.exemption_provisions: VERIFIED FACT: Statutory exemption applies to goods manufactured domestically exclusively for export. PENDING VERIFICATION: Specific phased enforcement transition dates for Micro and Small Enterprises under subsequent DPIIT facilitation orders.

source.gazette_citation: Gazette of India Extraordinary Part II Sec 3(ii) S.O. 4333(E)
source.curator_notes: Verified against BIS official Product Manual PM/IS 14220 and DPIIT Gazette notification S.O. 4333(E).
